name: Schema.org SocialMediaPosting
description: Adds Schema.org/SocialMediaPosting JSON-LD structured data (Schema.org Metatag).
project_description:
This module provides the following Schema.org types:

 
 schema.org/SocialMediaPosting 
 schema.org/BlogPosting 
 schema.org/LiveBlogPosting 
 schema.org/DiscussionForumPosting 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Schema.org Metatag module 2.x or higher. 
 
 Usage 
 If you want to provide metadata for the schema.org types SocialMediaPosting , BlogPosting or DiscussionForumPosting :

 
 Enable the schema_social_media_posting module. 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Search and metadata > Metatag ( /admin/config/search/metatag ) and click the button "Add default meta tags". 
 Select your entity type and bundle, expand the " Schema.org: SocialMediaPosting" fieldset and fill in the field mappings you want to publish.
 
 If you want to provide metadata for the schema.org type LiveBlogPosting :

 
 Enable the schema_live_blog_posting module. 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Search and metadata > Metatag ( /admin/config/search/metatag ) and click the button "Add default meta tags". 
 Select your entity type and bundle, expand the " Schema.org: LiveBlogPosting" fieldset and fill in the field mappings you want to publish.
